name: Tempester n°58: one MIDI output channel per pad (sequencer and live pads), stored in the System settings file
explanation: Dependency: requires n°9b (patch/nrpn_emission.json) for its SENDCC routine at 0x9d07a504. Why: the stock OS sends sequencer notes for one pad only (the Sequencer Sound, on the Sequencer Out channel); users want to sequence several external synths, one channel per pad (Docs/user-requests.md row 5). Table: one byte per pad at [address] + pad (.bss, 0 at boot): 0 = stock routing, 1-16 = that channel with the note the pad plays (event pitch: chromatic, 16 Tunings heard), 17-32 = channel (byte - 16) with the pad's « MIDI Note: Pad » note, 33-255 = as 0. A pad with a channel sends there instead of its stock route, DIN then USB. Sequencer: the seven calls of [routine] that precede the seven stock sequencer MIDI sends (slot in s0) go to HON / HOFF / HOFFA: a pad at 0 jumps to [routine] itself; a pad with a channel sends here (saving every register [routine] does not always write, hi / lo too) and returns 0, so the stock code takes its non-Sequencer-Sound path (same bookkeeping). HOFFA ([routine]) sends only for a slot still sounding. Live pads: at the entry of [routine] / [routine], a pad with a channel tail-calls [routine] / [routine] directly. Setting over MIDI on Remote Pad IN (CC 12-27 jump table entries [address]-[address], main loop): CC 15 = pad 0-31 addressed (answered by CC 16 = its value on Remote Pad OUT), CC 16 = value 0-32 of the addressed pad, CC 17 = 127 saves the System settings file if a value changed and the transport is stopped (the stock save stops it). Persistence: the high byte of the pad's « MIDI Note: Pad » halfword in the System settings file (written 0 and dropped at load by the stock OS); save loop [address] and load loop [address] rewritten. RAM [address]-[address]. Factory reset of the System settings ([routine], its call of [routine] at [address]) clears the table. Code [address]-[address] (inside n°37's freed range). Proof: tools/sim_multichannel.py and its counter-proofs; Docs/analyses/feature-multichannel.md.

edits.why: j [address] ; [routine] (live pad note-on), entry: was "addiu sp,sp,-0x20" (redone in LON); delay slot "move a0,a1" kept
j [address] ; [routine] (live pad note-off), entry: was "addiu sp,sp,-0x20" (redone in LOFF); delay slot "move a0,a1" kept
j [address] ; System settings save, « MIDI Note: Pad » loop: was "lbu t7,0x31(a1)" (redone in SAVELOOP)
j [address] ; System settings load, « MIDI Note: Pad » loop: was "lhu t3,0x0(v1)" (redone in LOADLOOP)
jal [address] ; [routine] (all sequencer slots off): was "jal [address]"; delay slot "nop" kept; s0 = slot
jal [address] ; [routine] (active slots of a type off): was "jal [address]"; delay slot "nop" kept; s0 = slot
jal [address] ; [routine], duration over: was "jal [address]"; delay slot "nop" kept; s0 = slot
jal [address] ; [routine], same note again: was "jal [address]"; delay slot "nop" kept; s0 = slot
jal [address] ; [routine], note-on: was "jal [address]"; delay slot "nop" kept; s0 = slot
jal [address] ; [routine] (System settings to factory values): was "jal [address]", made by RESET as a tail call; delay slot "nop" kept
jal [address] ; [routine] (slots of a pad off): was "jal [address]"; delay slot "nop" kept; s0 = slot
jal [address] ; [routine] (slot reuse): was "jal [address]"; delay slot "nop" kept; s0 = slot
b [address] ; sequencer note-on site. Live: s0 = slot; v0, v1, a0, a1 are written by [routine] on every path
li a1,0x1 ; delay slot: mode 1 = note-on
b [address] ; sequencer note-off sites (slot bit 0 already cleared, or tested by the caller)
or a1,zero,zero ; delay slot: mode 0 = note-off
li a1,0x2 ; mode 2 = note-off of a slot still sounding only ([routine] does not test bit 0)
lbu v0,0x3(s0) ; pad of the slot
beq v1,zero,[address] ; not a pad 0-31: stock
lbu v0,-0x7cf0(v0) ; table byte of the pad, [address] + pad
lw v1,0x0(s0) ; delay slot: slot flags
beq v1,zero,[address] ; mode 2, slot not sounding: nothing to send (its note-off already left)
addiu sp,sp,-0x50 ; 16-byte argument area, then every register [routine] does not always write
lbu t3,0x5(s0) ; note of the slot (event pitch)
lbu t3,-0x3463(t4) ; « MIDI Note: Pad » [address] + pad
ori t9,t9,0xfda8 ; [routine]: note-off (8n note 0, then USB)
addiu t9,t9,0x68 ; [routine]: note-on (9n note velocity, then USB)
lbu a2,0x4(s0) ; velocity of the slot
or v0,zero,zero ; delay slot: 0, the stock code skips its own send (not the Sequencer Sound)
j [address] ; stock routing: [routine] itself, returns to the site
sltiu v0,a1,0x20 ; live note-on. Live: a1 = pad, a2 = pitch, a3 = velocity, a0 = a1 (delay slot of the hook); v0 is written by the stock path's first call
lbu v0,-0x7cf0(v0) ; table byte of the pad
lbu a2,-0x3463(v0) ; « MIDI Note: Pad » [address] + pad
j [address] ; [routine](channel - 1, note, velocity), a tail call as the stock one at [address]
j [address] ; back to the stock body
or a0,a1,zero ; delay slot: the stock "move a0,a1"
sltiu v0,a1,0x20 ; live note-off. Live: a1 = pad, a2 = pitch, a0 = a1
lbu v0,-0x7cf0(v0) ; table byte of the pad
j [address] ; [routine](channel - 1, note, 0), a tail call as the stock one
j [address] ; back to the stock body
or a0,a1,zero ; delay slot: the stock "move a0,a1"
sltiu t0,a2,0x20 ; CC 15. Live: a2 = value, channel already accepted (Remote Pad IN); ra is a temporary here (the epilogue at [address] reloads it, and s0-s8)
lbu t2,0x49ec(gp) ; Remote Pad OUT [address] (0 = Off)
lbu a2,-0x7cf0(t3) ; value of the pad
movz a2,zero,t4 ; > 32 answered as 0 (a data byte stays below 0x80)
jal 0x9d07a504 ; SENDCC(Remote Pad OUT - 1, 16, value): DIN then USB
j [address] ; the default case, as before for CC 15-17: "b [address] / clear a1" (return 0)
beq t2,a2,[address] ; unchanged: nothing to save
sb t3,-0x7ccf(gp) ; delay slot: [address] = changed since the last save
lbu t1,-0x7ccf(gp) ; delay slot: changed since the last save
beq t1,zero,[address] ; nothing changed: no flash write
lw t2,0x1934(gp) ; delay slot: transport [address] (0 stopped; 1-3 play / record)
bne t2,zero,[address] ; playing or recording: not now (the stock save stops the transport first); still to save
jal [address] ; the stock System settings save (writes the table with the settings)
stock: « MIDI Note: Pad » byte, a1 = [address] + pad, t8 = [address], a0 = halfword in the buffer
lbu at,-0x7cf0(at) ; table byte of the pad
or at,at,t7 ; high byte = table, low byte = note (the stock OS drops the high byte at load)
j [address] ; after the stock loop: a0, a1, s0, t7 as it leaves them
stock: halfword of the file, v1 = buffer, a0 = [address] + pad, s8 = [address] | stock | stock: « MIDI Note: Pad » = low byte
sb t2,-0x7cf0(at) ; table byte = high byte (0 in a file written by any other OS)
j [address] ; after the stock loop: t2, t3, t9, a0, v1 as it leaves them
addiu t0,gp,-0x7cf0 ; System settings factory reset ([routine], also run at boot before the load): table [address], every pad back to 0. Live: a call site, every caller-saved register free; s0 kept
sb zero,-0x7cd0(gp) ; no pad addressed by CC 15
j [address] ; the replaced call, as a tail call (returns into [routine])
.word [address] ; CC 12-27 jump table of [routine] (event 10), CC 15: was [address] (default case)
